entities.name: William de Croÿ
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cardinal Guillaume, Guillermo or William de Croÿ, a member of the noble House of Croÿ, was Prince-Bishop of Cambrai from 1516 to 1519 and Archbishop of Toledo from 1517 to 1521. He was born in the Habsburg Netherlands and died in Worms, Germany.
